reports.name: Qcrs.cpi-3B (CSCR6)
reports.marker: wPt10505, wPt2277 (flanking); gwm0181 (closest SSR, about 2.2 cM)
reports.pve: up to 49 (43 with Rht1 as cofactor)
reports.note: Major crown rot QTL on 3BL from the T. spelta accession CSCR6, flanked by DArT markers wPt10505 and wPt2277; detected with both F. pseudograminearum and F. graminearum isolates; up to 49% of phenotypic variance (LOD 10.8, interval mapping). Not co-located with known plant-height genes, but a strong interaction with Rht1 (4BS) was found; with Rht1 as cofactor the maximum effect fell to 43%. In four validation populations the QTL alone reduced crown rot severity by 29-42% (mean 33%). The flanking DArT markers have no physical position; the locus is placed at the RefSeq v1.0 position of gwm0181 (in-silico PCR), about 2.2 cM away. The same locus was later fine-mapped (see Qcrs.cpi-3B, Zheng et al.). Corrected from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad13.py).
reports.evidence: Results: Qcrs.cpi-3B flanked by wPt10505 and wPt2277; up to 49% (LOD 10.8); gwm0181 about 2.2 cM; validation 29-42% (mean 33%)

reports.name: qCR-6B
reports.note: Crown rot QTL in 168 durum wheat genotypes (DArTseq GWAS), field crown rot nursery at Warwick 2017; CR severity index from whitehead percentage and stem browning: five SNPs at 100.13-101.26 cM on the Svevo consensus map, peak 1023342 (-log10(P) 4.20). The same markers gave the whitehead QTL qWH1-6B (-log10(P) up to 3.88) and qWH2-6B (up to 3.58), and the yield QTL qGY-6B in the CR nursery. Haplotype hap1 gave 0.79 t/ha more yield under crown rot, a 4.24 d longer grain-filling period and higher root biomass; combined with qSRA-6A (root angle) the yield advantage was 0.90 t/ha. Positions are not printed in the paper; the interval is the RefSeq v1.0 span of the DArTseq tags placed by BLAST (4992135 668.534 Mb, 2254131 667.201 Mb, 2256390 674.327 Mb); 1023342 and 1039837 could not be placed. Corrected from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad14.py).

DON; 19.04 cM; r2 0.06. The SNP is named by its IWGSC chromosome survey sequence scaffold and only a cM position is given, so it cannot be placed. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad23.py).
reports.evidence: Arruda et al. 2016 Mol Breed Table 2: IWGSC_CSS_1DS_scaff_1879930_3352; DON; 19.04 cM; r2 0.06

reports.name: FHB resistance gene linked to B1 (Sumai 3)
reports.note: One of the two major additive FHB resistance genes of Sumai 3 (also in Saikai 165) is linked in repulsion to the awn-inhibitor gene B1 on 5AL: recombination 15.1 +/- 3.3% in Sumai 3/Gamenya DH lines and 21.4 +/- 4.3% in Sumai 3/Emblem DH lines (greenhouse and field tests, F. graminearum). Placed at the cloned B1 gene (TraesCS5A02G542800); the resistance gene lies about 15-21 cM from it. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).
reports.evidence: Table 6: recombination between FHB resistance and awnedness 15.12% and 21.43%

reports.name: FHB chromosome effect 5A (U-136.1; monosomic analysis)
reports.note: Back-cross reciprocal monosomic analysis of Hungarian winter wheat line U-136.1 (Sagvari/Nobeokabozu-komugi//Mini-Mano/Sumai 3) against Hobbit sib, F. culmorum spray inoculation (Tulln). Chromosome 5A of U-136.1 enhanced FHB resistance. Affected head symptoms and grain damage. Whole-chromosome effect: no position. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).

reports.name: Tsn1 (SNB-susceptible US winter wheats)
reports.note: SnToxA sensitivity (Tsn1) in 32% of the NE-sensitive SNB-susceptible US winter wheat cultivars (infiltration with culture filtrates of 33 southeastern US isolates and SnToxA expressed in Pichia). Xfcp623 (internal to Tsn1) was the only diagnostic marker of ten tested. Survey of a known gene; placed at the Tsn1 position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).
reports.evidence: Table 3; Table 2: Xfcp623 internal to Tsn1 (5BL)

reports.name: Snn3-B1 (SNB-susceptible US winter wheats)
reports.note: SnTox3 sensitivity (Snn3) in 64% of the NE-sensitive SNB-susceptible US winter wheat cultivars; none were sensitive to SnTox1 (Snn1) and Snn2 markers were not diagnostic. Markers Xcfd20 and Xgwm234 for Snn3-5B were not diagnostic. Survey of a known gene; placed at the Snn3-B1 position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (Alsen, Carberry, ND3085, ND744)
reports.note: Validation in 14 doubled haploid breeding populations from Sumai 3-derived parents (FHB nurseries at Portage la Prairie and Carman, MB): Alsen, Carberry, ND3085 and ND744 carry Fhb1 as Sumai 3 does; no evidence for Glenn. Nursery selection raised the frequency of resistant Fhb1 marker alleles; Xgwm493 and Xgwm533 recommended for selection. Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).
reports.evidence: Tables 3-5: chi-square and t tests on Fhb1 markers

reports.name: Fhb5 (Alsen, Carberry, ND3085, ND744)
reports.note: Validation in the same 14 DH populations: Alsen, Carberry, ND3085 and ND744 carry Fhb5 (Qfhs.ifa-5A) as Sumai 3 does; Xgwm150, Xgwm304 and Xgwm595 recommended for selection. Xgwm150 could not be placed and Xgwm595 places on distal 5AL, away from the pericentromeric Fhb5; placed at the Fhb5 interval in the atlas (Xgwm304 105.4 Mb to Xgwm415 214.2 Mb), a wide pericentromeric region. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).
reports.evidence: Tables 3-5: chi-square and t tests on Fhb5 markers

reports.name: Rmg8 (S-615; Anh 2015)
reports.note: New gene Rmg8 for resistance to Triticum isolate Br48 of Pyricularia oryzae in hexaploid wheat S-615 (seedlings and heads); F2 of S-615 x Hope (93 plants), flanked by Xwmc317 and Xbarc159 on distal 2BL. Only Xwmc317 could be placed (784.343 Mb, Zhao et al. 2019 J Genet (Table S1)); position is that marker. The cloned Rmg8 is absent from Chinese Spring; its closest homologue is at 796 Mb (atlas record R077). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).
reports.evidence: Fig. 3: Rmg8 map, Xwmc317 and Xbarc159

reports.name: Rmg7 (St24, tetraploid; Anh 2015)
reports.note: Rmg7 in tetraploid St24 mapped with 94 F3 lines of St24 x Tat14, flanked by Xcfd50 and Xhbg327 on distal 2AL; Rmg7 and Rmg8 may be homoeologous. Neither marker could be placed; placed at the Rmg7 position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).
reports.evidence: Fig. 3: Rmg7 map, Xcfd50 and Xhbg327

reports.name: Pch1 (Burt and Nicholson 2011)
reports.note: Ae. ventricosa-derived Pch1 on 7DL located to a 0.26 cM interval between Xwg7S (with co-segregating Xcos7-6, X4CD7A8, Xorw5, Xtr383) and Xcos7-9 in a BC6F2 population (HS x RVPM25), using COS markers from Brachypodium chromosome 1 (364 kb region), rice 6 and sorghum 10. The COS and STS markers cannot be placed on Chinese Spring; placed at the Pch1 interval in the atlas (Xwmc14/Xbarc97/Xcfd175). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).
reports.evidence: Results: Pch1 in 0.26 cM between Xwg7S and Xcos7-9

reports.name: Pch2 (Cappelle Desprez 7A; Burt and Nicholson 2011)
reports.note: Homoeologous COS markers extended the Pch2 QTL on 7AL distal to Xcfa2040 (LOD > 15.2, 14 cM region) in the CS x CS/CD7A F2 population; Pch1 and Pch2 are potentially homoeoloci. Placed at Xcfa2040 (717.078 Mb, in-silico PCR). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).
reports.evidence: Results: Pch2 QTL LOD > 15.2 distal to Xcfa2040

reports.name: Fhb-7EL (FHB)
reports.note: Major FHB resistance locus Fhb-7EL mapped to the most distal (telomeric) end of Th. elongatum 7EL using 7EL-7el1L bread wheat recombinant lines (Th. ponticum 7el1L of line T4 on 7DL, carrying Lr19 and Sr25); reduced F. graminearum severity and fungal biomass in grains by over 95%. Likely the same locus as Fhb7. The locus is on a Thinopyrum elongatum 7EL segment in wheat 7DL recombinants and has no counterpart position in Chinese Spring. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).

reports.name: Fhb-7EL (crown rot)
reports.note: The same Fhb-7EL locus was effective against F. culmorum and F. pseudograminearum, the main agents of crown rot. The locus is on a Thinopyrum elongatum 7EL segment in wheat 7DL recombinants and has no counterpart position in Chinese Spring. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (Ning 7840 x Clark; SNP map)
reports.note: Seven EST-derived SNP markers mapped between Xgwm533 and Xgwm493 in 71 Ning 7840/Clark BC7F7 RILs; five in a 1.1 cM marker-dense region gave the highest R2 (45-54%) and LOD (9.0-11.6), the most likely Fhb1 location; Xsts3B-138 and Xsnp3BS-11 had the largest R2. Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).

reports.name: snbTM (durum, S12-1)
reports.note: Single SNB resistance gene snbTM in durum line S12-1 (RILs of Sceptre/3-6, Sceptre/S9-10, Sceptre/S12-1); RAPD markers UBC521650 and RC37510 flank it at about 15 and 13 cM. RC37510 is also linked (37.1 cM) to the red seed colour gene, consistent with its location on 3A. RAPD markers cannot be placed. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad24.py).

reports.name: Tsn1 (ToxA1 of Bipolaris sorokiniana)
reports.note: Preprint (not peer reviewed). ToxA1 cloned from Indian B. sorokiniana and expressed; infiltration of 18 Tsn1/tsn1 genotypes at seedling and adult stage confirmed the inverse gene-for-gene ToxA-Tsn1 interaction for spot blotch susceptibility (largest necrosis on K68, Tsn1; smallest on WAMI280, tsn1). Survey of a known gene; placed at the Tsn1 position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad25.py).
reports.evidence: Results: necrosis area on Tsn1 and tsn1 genotypes

reports.name: Tsn1 (Iranian and world cultivars)
reports.note: Preprint (not peer reviewed). Reaction of 40 wheat genotypes (19 Iranian cultivars, 16 world cultivars, five differentials) to 33 P. nodorum isolates and occurrence of necrotrophic effector sensitivity genes: Tsn1 present in 70% of highly susceptible cultivars and absent from all resistant ones; SnToxA infiltration caused necrosis only on Tsn1 cultivars. Survey of a known gene; placed at the Tsn1 position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad25.py).

reports.name: Snn1 (Iranian and world cultivars)
reports.note: Preprint (not peer reviewed). Reaction of 40 wheat genotypes (19 Iranian cultivars, 16 world cultivars, five differentials) to 33 P. nodorum isolates and occurrence of necrotrophic effector sensitivity genes: Snn1 SnTox1-Snn1 was the most frequent effector-gene pair in Iranian isolates and cultivars (100%); cultivars with Tsn1, Snn1 and Snn3 were susceptible to all isolates. Survey of a known gene; placed at the Snn1 position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad25.py).

reports.name: Snn3-B1 (Iranian and world cultivars)
reports.note: Preprint (not peer reviewed). Reaction of 40 wheat genotypes (19 Iranian cultivars, 16 world cultivars, five differentials) to 33 P. nodorum isolates and occurrence of necrotrophic effector sensitivity genes: Snn3-B1 Snn3 was detected in all Iranian cultivars and in 62.5% of world cultivars. Survey of a known gene; placed at the Snn3-B1 position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad25.py).

reports.name: Stb6 (cultivars worldwide)
reports.note: Resistance to M. graminicola isolate IPO323 in many cultivars used in wheat breeding worldwide was attributed to Stb6; eleven Xgwm369 alleles (closely linked to Stb6) were found, and pedigrees combined with Xgwm369 alleles indicate several independent entries of Stb6 into breeding programmes. Survey of a known gene; placed at the Stb6 position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad25.py).

reports.name: Pch2 candidate region (cDNA-AFLP)
reports.note: cDNA-AFLP of Chinese Spring versus CS/Cappelle Desprez 7A (Pch2) with Oculimacula acuformis: 34 of about 4,700 fragments differed; 14 clones mapped to 7A and three in the Pch2 region, notably 4CD7A8 (homologous to a rice callose synthase) and 19CD7A4 (homologous to the cereal cyst nematode NBS-LRR protein RCCN). Most differences appear to be allelic rather than expression differences. Placed at the Pch2 interval in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad25.py).
reports.evidence: Results: fragments mapped to the Pch2 region

reports.name: Qfhs.ndsu-3AS (T. dicoccoides; saturation map)
reports.note: Type II FHB resistance QTL from T. dicoccoides chromosome 3A in 83 Langdon x LDN(DIC-3A) RICLs: Xgwm2 most significant (P < 0.00001, 38%); CIM explained 42% within an 11.5 cM interval flanked by TRAP loci Xfcp401 and Xfcp397.2; not homoeologous to Qfhs.ndsu-3BS. TRAP markers cannot be placed; placed at the peak marker Xgwm2 (60.201 Mb, in-silico PCR). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad25.py).

reports.name: QWB 2AS (2NvS) (Alvorada x Sossego)
reports.note: Wheat blast QTL in the TBIO Alvorada x TBIO Sossego population (4,169 SNPs; field Quirusillas, Bolivia 2017 and 2019; greenhouse Bolivia and Brazil). Resistance allele from TBIO Sossego. Detections: field 2017 severity LOD 17.5 (33.5%), incidence 23.0 (40.0%); field 2019 severity 44.7 (67.1%), incidence 52.6 (73.0%); greenhouse Bolivia severity 60.2 (75.8%), AUDPC 30.2 (52.7%); greenhouse Brazil severity 77.2 (82.4%), AUDPC 56.5 (74.1%). The locus corresponds to the Ae. ventricosa 2NvS translocation on 2AS; the markers are placed at their Chinese Spring positions on 2AS. Placed in silico: IWB9863 17.226 Mb (Sun et al. 2020 PBJ (90K)), IWB36110 15.613 Mb (Sun et al. 2020 PBJ (90K)). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad26.py).

reports.name: Stb6 region (Swiss landraces)
reports.note: GWAS of a historic Swiss landrace collection with four Swiss Z. tritici isolates: one SNP (Excalibur_c34649556) on 3A at 26,461,994 bp associated with necrosis and pycnidia for isolate 1E4, 255 kb from Stb6; 66% of landraces carry the functional Stb6-1 allele and seven new Stb6 alleles were found. Responses to the other isolates were quantitative with no significant SNP. Position as printed (RefSeq v1.0). Uploaded as the Research Square preprint; the published article and its correction (Euphytica 217:175) were consulted for the citation. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad26.py).

reports.name: tsc2 (Ptr ToxB insensitivity, ITMI)
reports.note: Resistance to Ptr race 5 (conidial inoculation) and sensitivity to Ptr ToxB in the W-7984 x Opata 85 (ITMI) recombinant inbred population. The ToxB-insensitivity gene, designated tsc2, mapped to the distal tip of 2BS, 4.3 cM from Xfbb274, and underlay the major QTL for resistance to race 5 (69% of the variation; resistance from Opata 85). Placed at the Tsc2 position in the atlas (Corsi et al. 2020). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad27.py).

reports.name: QTs.fcu-4A (race 5, ITMI)
reports.note: Resistance to Ptr race 5 (conidial inoculation) and sensitivity to Ptr ToxB in the W-7984 x Opata 85 (ITMI) recombinant inbred population. Minor QTL at Xksu916(Oxo), R2 20%, resistance from W-7984. Oxalate oxidase candidate locus on 4AL; with tsc2 explains 73% of the variation. The RFLP probe cannot be placed on Chinese Spring, so the locus is unplaced. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad27.py).

reports.name: QTs.fcu-2B (race 5, ITMI)

reports.name: QTs.fcu-2A (race 5, ITMI)

This 1AS chlorosis-resistance locus of W-7984 is the Tsc1 region; placed at the Tsc1 position in the atlas (Running et al. 2022). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad27.py).

reports.name: Fhb-7el2 (Th. ponticum 7el2L in durum)
reports.note: FHB resistance QTL Fhb-7el2 from the Thinopyrum ponticum 7el2L arm, transferred from a bread wheat 7DS.7el2L translocation into durum 7AS.7AL-7el1L recombinant lines (carrying Lr19 and Sr25 from another Th. ponticum accession); the 7el1L+7el2L tetraploid lines had 70-85% lower FHB severity and lower fungal biomass in kernels; similar effects in bread wheat lines with the same assembly on 7DL. The locus is on an alien segment and has no counterpart position in Chinese Spring. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad27.py).

reports.name: Xbarc197 association (take-all, 100 bread wheats)
reports.note: Stepwise regression of take-all (Gaeumannomyces tritici) disease severity on SSR, IRAP and wheat-rye translocation markers in 100 bread wheat genotypes (greenhouse): DS = 67.03 - 18.23 Xbarc56-1 + 14.14 Xbarc197-7 - 25.64 LTR14 (R2 21%); allele 7 of Xbarc197 increased severity. Xbarc56 and the IRAP marker LTR14 (the strongest, lowering severity) cannot be placed and their chromosomes are not given. Placed at Xbarc197 (492.894 Mb, Zhao et al. 2019 J Genet). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad27.py).

reports.name: FHB chromosome effect 6B (T. macha in Hobbit sib)
reports.note: Inter-varietal chromosome substitution lines tested for FHB in mist-irrigated field trials (Austria 1994-1996, F. graminearum and F. culmorum spray inoculation; SAUDPC and relative ear weight) and for toxin tolerance (Petritox test). Chromosome 6B of T. macha substituted into Hobbit sib: significantly higher resistance (SAUDPC) and higher DON and 3-AcDON tolerance. Whole-chromosome effect: no position. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (SRW wheat, Fhb1+Fhb7 pyramids)
reports.note: Gene-based markers for Fhb1 (TaHRC-R/S) and Fhb7 (the GST ORF) screened in 57 soft red winter wheat breeding lines from crosses introducing Fhb7 into Fhb1 lines (Purdue); 15 lines carried both resistant alleles and two years of inoculated trials showed the Fhb1+Fhb7 combination lowered DON. Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (Ning 7840 x Clark; AFLP/STS)
reports.note: Major 3BS FHB QTL in Ning 7840/Clark RILs (type II resistance): five PstI-AFLPs associated, three explaining 38-51% of the variation; pAG/mCAA244 (in repulsion) was converted into the STS marker SRST.3B1, whose resistant band matched the pedigrees of Ning 7840 and Sumai 3 derived cultivars. Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: Sr2 (STM markers at Xgwm533)
reports.note: Sequence-tagged microsatellites developed at the Xgwm533 locus discriminate the 120-bp allele linked to adult-plant stem rust resistance gene Sr2 from a size-homoplasious allele, and were diagnostic for Sr2 across a wide range of germplasm; the locus is also associated with a major FHB resistance gene (Fhb1). Placed at the Sr2 position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).
reports.evidence: Results: STM genotypes of Sr2 carriers and non-carriers

reports.name: QFhb.pur-2BS (low incidence, narrow flower opening)
reports.note: Patterson x Goldfield RILs (100 lines; six environments, misted and non-misted field tests): narrow, brief flower opening of Goldfield associated with low FHB incidence (passive resistance). QTL in the Xbarc200-Xgwm210 interval on 2BS, 29% of the variation for incidence over six environments (LOD 5.21), also associated with narrow flower opening in three of five tests; Goldfield allele. Only Xgwm210 could be placed (3.405 Mb, in-silico PCR). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: FHB incidence association at Xwmc149
reports.note: Patterson x Goldfield RILs (100 lines; six environments, misted and non-misted field tests): narrow, brief flower opening of Goldfield associated with low FHB incidence (passive resistance). Xwmc149 (not linked to Xbarc200-Xgwm210) explained 12% of the variation for incidence. Placed at Xwmc149 (779.110 Mb, Zhao et al. 2019 J Genet (Table S1)). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: FHB incidence association at Xgwm344
reports.note: Patterson x Goldfield RILs (100 lines; six environments, misted and non-misted field tests): narrow, brief flower opening of Goldfield associated with low FHB incidence (passive resistance). reports.name: Fhb7 (high-density map; shortened translocations)

Fhb7 lies on an alien segment and has no counterpart position in Chinese Spring. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: QFhb 5B (Solitar x Bussard)

reports.name: Rht-D1 (FHB susceptibility; winter wheat families)
reports.note: GWAS within two winter wheat data sets (438 and 585 lines from six and eight bi-parental families) used to fit QTL as fixed effects in genomic prediction. The Rht-D1 locus accounted for 62.3% of the genotypic variance for FHB severity in data set 1 (allele substitution effect -10.86%) and about 13% in data set 2; Rht-D1b increases susceptibility. Placed at the Rht-D1 gene (TraesCS4D02G040400, 4D 18.781 Mb on RefSeq v1.0). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: Rht-D1 (STB susceptibility; winter wheat families)
reports.note: GWAS within two winter wheat data sets (438 and 585 lines from six and eight bi-parental families) used to fit QTL as fixed effects in genomic prediction. In data set 2 the Rht-D1 marker was also significantly associated with STB severity (about 13% of genotypic variance). Placed at the Rht-D1 gene (TraesCS4D01G040400). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: Fhb5 (Qfhs.ifa-5A; winter wheat families)
reports.note: GWAS within two winter wheat data sets (438 and 585 lines from six and eight bi-parental families) used to fit QTL as fixed effects in genomic prediction. In data set 2 wsnp_BE444720A_TA_2_1, in LD with Fhb5 crossed in from the exotic parents, explained 22.8% of the genotypic variance for FHB severity; Fhb1, also carried by the parents, was not detected. Placed at the marker (57.376 Mb, Sun et al. 2020 PBJ (90K)). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: FHB association on 4B (winter wheat families)
reports.note: GWAS within two winter wheat data sets (438 and 585 lines from six and eight bi-parental families) used to fit QTL as fixed effects in genomic prediction. A minor FHB association on 4B in data set 1 (not linked to Rht-B1, fixed for Rht-B1a); the marker is given only in the supplement, so the locus is unplaced. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad28.py).

reports.name: Wuhan 1 2D QTL (Chinese germplasm at CIMMYT)

Placed between Xwmc144 (267.082 Mb, Zhao et al. 2019 J Genet (Table S1)) and Xwmc245 (186.777 Mb, in-silico PCR / tag match on IWGSC RefSeq v1.0 (this atlas)). reports.name: Rht-D1 (FHB; European winter wheat varieties)
reports.note: Association mapping in 372 European winter wheat varieties (FHB scores from multi-environment trials; SSR, 9k and 90k SNP data): the functional marker was significantly (P < 0.005) associated with FHB resistance, and excluding it and linked markers lowered genomic prediction accuracy by 14-30%. Rht-D1b is associated with higher FHB; Rht-B1 was not significant (mutant allele in only 26 varieties). Placed at the Rht-D1 gene (TraesCS4D02G040400). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad29.py).

reports.name: Ppd-D1 (FHB; European winter wheat varieties)
reports.note: Association mapping in 372 European winter wheat varieties (FHB scores from multi-environment trials; SSR, 9k and 90k SNP data): the functional marker was significantly (P < 0.005) associated with FHB resistance, and excluding it and linked markers lowered genomic prediction accuracy by 14-30%. The association reflects the link between heading time and FHB. Placed at the Ppd-D1 gene (TraesCS2D02G079600). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad29.py).

reports.name: Rmg11 (St19, T. dicoccum)

Single dominant gene (91 F2:3 lines of St19 x St30) on 7AS between IMT_5 (1.0 cM distal) and IMT_6/IMT_7 (1.1 cM proximal), 2.2 cM distal of Xgwm635. Fig. 2 places the interval at about 5.3-5.7 Mb on durum Svevo v1.0; that position is used directly as an approximate RefSeq v2.1 position (Xgwm635 places at 16.6 Mb on RefSeq v1.0). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad29.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (261 kb BAC interval; UMN10)
reports.note: A Chinese Spring 3B BAC contig spanning Fhb1 (3BS) was built and sequenced; new markers narrowed Fhb1 to a 261 kb region with seven putative genes, four expressed in spikes but none differentially expressed after Fusarium inoculation. Sumai 3 cosmids covering all seven genes were transformed into Bobwhite; transgenics for four of five cosmids showed no type II resistance (the fifth was still under test). The codominant diagnostic marker UMN10 was developed for MAS. Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Entered from the abstract (full text not available), Nov 2026 (ad32.py).

reports.name: SbWE35

Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad33.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (CM82036; stacked in German spring wheat)

All three donor alleles significantly reduced DON content, and all but the Frontana 3A allele (low, non-significant effect on FHB severity) reduced FHB severity; 3B and 5A together reduced DON by 78% and FHB rating by 55%. reports.name: 3BS FHB QTL (Ning8331)

Loci on 3BS were most closely related to FHB resistance: Gwm493 with spike infection (R2 6.5%) and kernel infection (14.7%); Gwm389 with loss in kernel weight per head (14.7%), test weight (15.1%) and thousand kernel weight (17.7%). reports.name: C_6R FHB QTL (triticale, rye 6R)

reports.name: QTL_7 crown rot resistance 2B (Rahman 2021)

reports.name: Fhb1 region (Sumai 3 into Kitamoe backcross lines)
reports.note: Six 3BS SSRs tested on BC1F3 families of the FHB-susceptible Japanese winter wheat Kitamoe backcrossed with Sumai 3; families homozygous for the Sumai 3 alleles at barc133, barc147, gwm533.1 and barc102 had lower FHB severity than Kitamoe-type and heterozygous families (unlike barc87), suggesting recessive expression in the winter wheat background. Only Xbarc133 could be placed (7.608 Mb, in-silico PCR); position is that marker. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad36.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 = PFT (pore-forming toxin-like gene, Sumai 3)
reports.note: Map-based cloning of Fhb1 (Qfhs.ndsu-3BS) from Sumai 3: the 0.08-cM interval between STS3B-355 and STS3B-334 was covered by a Sumai 3 BAC contig, and mutation analysis, gene silencing and transgenic overexpression showed that a pore-forming toxin-like (PFT) gene, encoding a chimeric lectin with two agglutinin domains and an ETX/MTX2 toxin domain, confers FHB resistance. The Chinese Spring Fhb1 region lacks an active copy. Placed at the Fhb1 position in the atlas (TaHRC, Su et al. 2019, which identified a different causal gene at the same locus). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad36.py).

reports.name: 1DS FHB QTL at RGA XaACT/CAA (Cansas x Ritmo)
reports.note: The barley Mla-linked RGA marker aACT/CAA was assigned to 1DS with Chinese Spring aneuploids and mapped in 96 F5 RILs of Cansas x Ritmo 13.0 cM from Xgwm106; it explained 12% of FHB variance by single-marker regression, and composite interval mapping across four environments gave a LOD of 3.2 (14.5%) for this 1DS QTL. The RGA itself could not be placed. Only Xgwm106 could be placed (18.819 Mb, in-silico PCR); position is that marker. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad36.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (family-pedigree mapping in SDSU breeding populations)

Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad36.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (CM-82036; MABC into European winter wheat)

reports.name: FHB association 2B/3A (Xbarc45; European winter wheat)
reports.note: Genome-wide association mapping of FHB rating in 455 European soft winter wheat lines (two environments, several ratings) with 115 SSRs and Rht-B1/Rht-D1 markers; nine significant associations on seven chromosomes, three remaining after Bonferroni-Holm correction (1B, 1D, 2D). Xbarc45 maps to 2B or 3A (4/37 cM), 3.4% of genotypic variance, P < 0.05; chromosome ambiguous, so unplaced. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad36.py).

reports.name: Rht-D1 FHB susceptibility (European winter wheat)
reports.note: Genome-wide association mapping of FHB rating in 455 European soft winter wheat lines (two environments, several ratings) with 115 SSRs and Rht-B1/Rht-D1 markers; nine significant associations on seven chromosomes, three remaining after Bonferroni-Holm correction (1B, 1D, 2D). The dwarfing locus Rht-D1 (marker sw4brht2) was associated with FHB rating (4.2% of genotypic variance, P < 0.05), the dwarfing allele increasing susceptibility; an epistatic interaction involved Rht-B1. Placed at the Rht-D1 gene (TraesCS4D02G040400, gene table). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad36.py).

reports.name: Qfhs.ndsu-3AS (T. dicoccoides; validated in Argentine durum)
reports.note: Langdon(Dic-3A)-10 carrying Qfhs.ndsu-3AS (type II resistance from T. turgidum ssp. dicoccoides) was crossed with Argentine durum cultivars; F4 progeny screened with the tightly linked Xgwm2 and point-inoculated with F. graminearum. Carriers (heterozygous or homozygous) had significantly lower severity at 21 dpi and slower disease progress than the cultivated parents, showing stable dominant expression in durum backgrounds. Only Xgwm2 could be placed (60.201 Mb, in-silico PCR); position is that marker. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: QStb.ipk-1D
reports.note: STB resistance in 65 ITMI RILs (W7984 x Opata 85) inoculated with Argentine isolates IPO 92067 and IPO 93014 at seedling and adult stages; RFLP-based ITMI map. Seedling QTL on distal 1DS, both isolates (LOD 3.0 or more with IPO 92067), resistance from W7984. Markers read from Fig. 2; RFLP loci, not placed. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: QStb.ipk-2D

reports.name: Stb5 (Ae. tauschii 7D introgression lines)
reports.note: Thirteen Chinese Spring/Ae. tauschii chromosome 7D introgression lines, CS and CS(Syn 7D) tested with Argentine isolates IPO 92067 and IPO 93014 at seedling and adult stages (two locations, 2003-2004); resistance was effective against both isolates at both stages and mapped to the centromeric region of 7DS; from its relationship with Xgwm44 the gene is likely Stb5. Only Xgwm44 could be placed (96.469 Mb, in-silico PCR); position is that marker. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: FHB QTL 3BS (Fhb1) (Canadian molecular breeding)
reports.note: Molecular breeding (high-throughput SSR genotyping and half-seed analysis) of four crosses to introduce six FHB resistance QTL from Sumai 3, Wuhan and Nyubai into Canadian spring wheat; QTL tracked with three markers each (Table 2). QTL 3BS (Fhb1): type II, distal 3BS, 33-cM interval. Only Xgwm493 could be placed (13.936 Mb, in-silico PCR); position is that marker. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: FHB QTL 3BSc (Canadian molecular breeding)
reports.note: Molecular breeding (high-throughput SSR genotyping and half-seed analysis) of four crosses to introduce six FHB resistance QTL from Sumai 3, Wuhan and Nyubai into Canadian spring wheat; QTL tracked with three markers each (Table 2). QTL 3BSc: type I, near the 3B centromere, 13-cM interval. Placed in silico: Xwmc625 245.359 Mb (Zhao et al. 2019 J Genet), Xgwm566 77.722 Mb (in-silico PCR). The markers span 168 Mb: a chromosome region, not a locus. Placements off the stated chromosome arm were discarded (approximate centromere 346 Mb): Xwmc418 619.9 Mb. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: Qfhs.jic-4d.1 at Rht-D1 (Spark x Rialto)
reports.note: FHB resistance (AUDPC, spray inoculation) in the Spark x Rialto DH population in three field trials (A2005, N2005, J2006); MQM mapping with DArT and SSR markers (LOD threshold 2.8). Major QTL coincident with Rht-D1: resistance from Spark (Rht-D1a), susceptibility associated with Rialto Rht-D1b; up to 52.7% (J2006, LOD 28.2), 50.9% across trials. Not an effect of height per se; near-isogenic lines showed Rht-D1b compromises type I resistance but not type II. Placed at the Rht-D1 gene (TraesCS4D02G040400, gene table). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

Closest markers cfd6, gdm67, gwm642 and cfd48 (3.1-cM cluster). Ae. longissima chromosome: no wheat RefSeq position. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (TaHRC diagnostic markers)
reports.note: Two functional markers based on the deletion in TaHRC (putative histidine-rich calcium-binding protein) in the Fhb1 region, developed by comparing near-isogenic lines and validated in populations and three diversity panels; diagnostic for Fhb1 and more accurate than earlier markers. Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: Dicer1 (DCL1) FHB association
reports.note: Candidate-gene association mapping (14 KASP markers in nine cross-kingdom RNA trafficking genes) in 356 GABI winter wheat lines, verified in the Apache x Biscay RIL population. Two markers in Dicer1 on 5A were associated with FHB severity (P 1.5e-4 and 9.0e-6) and verified in Apache x Biscay, without association with height or heading. DCL1(5AL) primers give one 447 bp product at 679.664 Mb, inside TraesCS5A02G516000. Gene located by exact-match in-silico PCR of the Online Resource 2 primers (T3/T7 tails removed), Nov 2026 (ad48.py).

reports.name: Ara6 (Rab5-like GTPase) FHB association
reports.note: Candidate-gene association mapping (14 KASP markers in nine cross-kingdom RNA trafficking genes) in 356 GABI winter wheat lines, verified in the Apache x Biscay RIL population. An intronic marker in Ara6 on 4D was associated with FHB severity (P 2.2e-4) and verified in Apache x Biscay, where it was also associated with plant height. Ara6(4DL) primers give one 562 bp product at 439.123 Mb, inside TraesCS4D02G267900. Gene located by exact-match in-silico PCR of the Online Resource 2 primers (T3/T7 tails removed), Nov 2026 (ad48.py).

reports.name: TsrHar (Ethiopian cultivars HAR604, HAR2562)
reports.note: Of 118 Ethiopian bread and durum wheats tested with P. tritici-repentis isolates ASC1a and DW-16, HAR604, HAR2562 and Dashen were resistant to both and carry allelic recessive resistance genes; monosomic analysis placed the gene, temporarily designated TsrHar, on 3B. Its relation to Tsr2 is unknown. Chromosome-level location only. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: Qfhs.pur-7EL (Th. ponticum 7el2)
reports.note: Type II FHB resistance mapped in a population from two wheat-Th. ponticum 7el substitution lines (el1, susceptible; el2, resistant): Qfhs.pur-7EL in the distal long arm of 7el2 between XBE445653 and Xcfa2240 reduced diseased spikelets by 1.5-2.6 and explained 15.1-32.5% in four experiments; 7el2-specific STS/EST markers developed. Alien chromosome: no wheat RefSeq position. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: Tsr1 (ND 735; race 2 necrosis insensitivity)
reports.note: Tan spot resistance in F1, F2 and 118 F2:6 RILs of ND 735 (R) x Steele-ND (S), seedlings tested with spore inocula and culture filtrates of P. tritici-repentis races 2 and 5. A single recessive gene, Tsr1, on 5BL controlled resistance and insensitivity to race 2 necrosis, flanked by wPt-8285 (7.0 cM) and wPt-3049 (2.9 cM). The DArT markers could not be placed; placed at the Tsn1 position in the atlas (Tsr1 is the tsn1 resistance allele). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: Tsr6 (ND 735; race 5 chlorosis insensitivity)
reports.note: Tan spot resistance in F1, F2 and 118 F2:6 RILs of ND 735 (R) x Steele-ND (S), seedlings tested with spore inocula and culture filtrates of P. tritici-repentis races 2 and 5. A second recessive gene, designated Tsr6, on 2BS conferred resistance and insensitivity to chlorosis induced by race 5 spores or culture filtrates, flanked by wPt-0289 (4.6 cM) and Xwmc25 (18.7 cM). The markers could not be placed; placed at the Tsc2 (Ptr ToxB sensitivity, 2BS) position in the atlas as the likely corresponding locus. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad37.py).

reports.name: Rmg10 (Ae. tauschii KU-2097)
reports.note: Of 199 Ae. tauschii accessions screened with Brazilian MoT isolate Br48, 14 were resistant; synthetic Ldn/KU-2097 was resistant at seedling and spike stages, and a single dominant gene, Rmg10, was mapped in Chinese Spring x Ldn/KU-2097 (86 F2:3 lines) to a 16.1-cM interval on 2DS between MS-4 (7.8 cM distal) and MS-12 (8.3 cM proximal), about 5.1 Mb in CS v2.1. Effective against Brazilian but not Bangladesh isolates; a Gladius/KU-2097 synthetic octoploid had lower blast index in Bolivian field tests. Placed at the mapped 2DS region shown in Fig. 5 (6.76-24.73 Mb, v2.1); the exact 5.1-Mb interval is not printed. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad38.py).

reports.name: Rmg7 (T. dicoccum St24; original report)
reports.note: A single gene, Rmg7, identified in tetraploid T. dicoccum St24 (KU120) against Triticum isolate Br48; St17 and St25 carry the same gene (no susceptible F2 from intercrosses), and a single corresponding avirulence gene was detected in Br48 x MZ5-1-6 progeny. No map position in this paper; placed at the Rmg7 position in the atlas (2AL, allele of Pm4; Asuke et al. 2024). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad38.py).

reports.name: Fhb8 / Qfdk.nau-7D (Wangshuibai)
reports.note: Qfdk.nau-7D from Wangshuibai (FDK) was transferred into susceptible PH691 by marker-assisted backcrossing; NILs showed it lowers FDK through resistance to infection and spread, and differ from PH691 in head length. Fine-mapped in a BC3F2 population (97 plants) with recombinant testing to a 1.0-cM interval Xwgrb1500-Xwgrb1559 (93.9-96.5 Mb in CS v2.1), co-segregating with Xwgrb1587, and designated Fhb8. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad38.py).

reports.name: FhbLoP (L. ponticum 7EL)

Alien chromosome: no wheat RefSeq position. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad38.py).

reports.name: Pch1 (European winter wheat; fine-mapping)
reports.note: GWAS for eyespot (field tests in three environments) in 168 European winter and 3 spring wheat varieties with 732 SSRs and 7,761 mapped 90K SNPs; 108 SSR and 235 SNP MTAs (-log10P 3.0 or more). Pch1 (T. ventricosum introgression on 7DL) was the main resistance source, present in 18 varieties (eyespot score 1.20-2.67 vs 3.43-5.73 without). Varieties with recombination in the introgression allowed fine-mapping to the distal 7DL region Traes_7DL_59D114555-Traes_4D32A4BE1, which contains the CC-NBS-LRR gene Traes_7DL_973A33763 (marker AX-94525717), a candidate for Pch1. Placed at the Pch1 interval in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad38.py).

reports.name: Eyespot MTA 5A (XBARC303; European winter wheat)
reports.note: GWAS for eyespot (field tests in three environments) in 168 European winter and 3 spring wheat varieties with 732 SSRs and 7,761 mapped 90K SNPs; 108 SSR and 235 SNP MTAs (-log10P 3.0 or more). Besides the 7D markers, BARC303 (12.6 cM on 5A) was the only marker beyond the Bonferroni threshold; distant from the WMS639 QTL of Burt et al. (2011). Only Xbarc303 could be placed (47.949 Mb, Zhao et al. 2019 J Genet); position is that marker. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad38.py).

reports.name: Eyespot QTL region 2AS (European winter wheat)
reports.note: GWAS for eyespot (field tests in three environments) in 168 European winter and 3 spring wheat varieties with 732 SSRs and 7,761 mapped 90K SNPs; 108 SSR and 235 SNP MTAs (-log10P 3.0 or more). SSR and SNP data indicated a QTL region on 2AS supported by numerous markers, most alleles reducing eyespot score (smaller effects than Pch1); proposed as a novel resistance source. Online Resource 3 lists the SSRs WMS0830 (15.4 cM, -log10P up to 4.58, R2 9.8%), WMS0636 (37.3 cM, 4.30, 9.5%) and WMS0359 (52.4 cM, 3.23, 7.9%), each with an allele that reduces eyespot (WMS0830 null, WMS0636 106, WMS0359 215). Xgwm830 could not be placed. Marker positions (RefSeq v1.0): Xgwm636 4.977 Mb (in-silico PCR); Xgwm359 28.205 Mb (in-silico PCR). Online Resource 4B lists 44 SNPs at 0.8, 4, 10.5, 28.1 cM (strongest Tdurum_contig63196_123, -log10P 5.28, R2 12.2%); 42 of 44 with the minor allele reducing eyespot. 22 SNPs placed in silico at 2.641-36.041 Mb (RefSeq v1.0; Hu et al. 2022 BMC Plant Biol (90K on v2.1); Sun et al. 2020 PBJ (90K)). The 10.5 cM block (37 SNPs, the peak of the region) places at 11.910-17.657 Mb. SSR data from Online Resource 3 (ad51.py); SNP data from Online Resource 4B, Nov 2026 (ad54.py).

reports.name: Qcrs.cpi-4B (Lang; soil-less seedling assay)
reports.note: A soil-less seedling assay for crown rot (inoculated seedlings in moist paper towel) applied to the Lang x CSCR6 RIL population detected only the 4B QTL from Lang (trial 1 Barc199-wPt-7569, LOD 3.0, 14.7%; combined LOD 4.0, 18.9%); the major 3BL QTL (Qcrs.cpi-3B) found with the soil-based assay was not detected, suggesting different genes act at different stages or assays. Placed in silico: Xbarc199 178.374 Mb (Zhao et al. 2019 J Genet), wPt-7569 453.777 Mb (DArT tag BLAST (this atlas)). The markers span 275 Mb: a chromosome region, not a locus. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 (CM82036; MAS vs phenotypic selection)
reports.note: Donor QTL alleles from CM82036 (Sumai 3/Thornbird; 3B, 5A) and Frontana (3A) combined in German spring wheat by a double cross; two- and three-step phenotypic selection compared with marker-based selection (one to three flanking markers per QTL), tested with F. culmorum at four locations in 2004. All selection variants reduced FHB severity and DON; three-step phenotypic selection gave the highest total gain, marker selection for the two CM82036 alleles the highest gain per year. Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: QLr.icg-5B (T. timopheevii introgression)
reports.note: Common wheat introgression lines carrying T. timopheevii segments, developed by marker-assisted backcrossing of two BC1F20 T. aestivum*2/T. timopheevii lines into Saratovskaya 29 (SSR and in situ hybridisation characterisation), tested with the West Siberian P. triticina population. Major leaf rust resistance locus on the introgressed 5GL segment; lines with a single 5GL introgression were completely resistant. Originally mapped by Leonova et al. (2008, 2011); no marker positions in this paper, so not placed. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: QLr.icg-2A (T. timopheevii introgression)
reports.note: Common wheat introgression lines carrying T. timopheevii segments, developed by marker-assisted backcrossing of two BC1F20 T. aestivum*2/T. timopheevii lines into Saratovskaya 29 (SSR and in situ hybridisation characterisation), tested with the West Siberian P. triticina population. (2008, 2011); no marker positions in this paper, so not placed. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: Qfhs.pur-7EL (GBS remapping; 7el2 on wheat 7DL)
reports.note: GBS (1,700 SNPs) linkage and QTL mapping in a wheat-tall wheatgrass (Th. ponticum) introgression RIL population; the parents proved to be translocation lines in two wheat backgrounds rather than 7E-7D substitution lines in Thatcher. Type II FHB QTL Qfhs.pur-7EL mapped to a 2.9-cM region (four markers) within a 43.6-cM segment of 7el2 translocated onto 7DL; two linked SNPs converted to KASP markers; five lines carry the resistance alleles of Qfhs.pur-7EL and Lr19 in coupling. Alien chromatin: no wheat RefSeq position. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: Lr19 (GBS remapping; 7el1 on wheat 7DL)

reports.name: Lr19 (L. ponticum 7EL)

reports.name: Fhb1 (combined with Sr2)
reports.note: Of 1,949 F2 plants screened with Xgwm533 and csSr2 (Sr2) and UMN10/UMN10v2 (Fhb1), 43 had Fhb1 and Sr2 in coupling; 59 homozygous F3 spring lines carrying both had significantly lower FHB severity and moderate to high stem rust resistance in field nurseries. Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: Qcrs.cpi-3B (CSCR6; pyramiding)
reports.note: Pyramiding of three large-effect crown rot QTL in two populations (EGA Wylie//Lang/CSCR6, 178 lines; EGA Wylie/Sumai3 x CSCR6 derived, 181 F8 lines), seedling assays in four trials; lines with two resistant alleles beat those with one or none, and lines with all three were most resistant. Resistant allele from T. spelta CSCR6 reduced disease index by 25.5-28.5%. Placed at the Qcrs.cpi-3B interval in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: Qcrs.cpi-5D (EGA Wylie; pyramiding)
reports.note: Pyramiding of three large-effect crown rot QTL in two populations (EGA Wylie//Lang/CSCR6, 178 lines; EGA Wylie/Sumai3 x CSCR6 derived, 181 F8 lines), seedling assays in four trials; lines with two resistant alleles beat those with one or none, and lines with all three were most resistant. reports.name: Fhb1 = HisR/TaHRC (PFT not required)
reports.note: Lines carrying HisR (TaHRC) with or without PFT, and five HisR-carrying PFT mutants made by gene editing, showed that PFT does not confer FHB resistance and that the HisR effect does not require PFT; PFT mutations were not associated with morphological or phenological traits. This argues against PFT as the Fhb1 gene (Rawat et al. 2016) and supports HisR/TaHRC, about 50 kb from PFT. Placed at the cloned Fhb1 (TaHRC) position in the atlas. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: Fhb1 region SSCP markers (Ning 7840)
reports.note: EST-derived SSCP markers for the 3BS QTL (between Xgwm389 and Xgwm493) from Sumai 3 derivative Ning 7840 in a Ning 7840 x Clark population; Xsscp6, Xsscp20 and Xsscp21 mapped between Xgwm493 and Xgwm533 and explained more variation (R2 50, 47 and 46% in F6:7) than Xgwm533 (45%). Only Xgwm493 could be placed (13.936 Mb, in-silico PCR); position is that marker. Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: Snn3-D1 (cloned; protein kinase-major sperm protein)
reports.note: Map-based cloning of Snn3-D1 from Ae. tauschii (TA2377 x AL8/78 population, BAC contig on AL8/78 scaffold 5289): the gene encodes protein kinase and major sperm protein domains, both essential for SnTox3 sensitivity; the interaction is light-independent and expression is down-regulated by light. Snn3-D1 likely arose in Ae. tauschii through a ~218-kb insertion along the west bank of the Caspian Sea; its homoeolog TaPKMSP-5B lies on 5B. Placed at the Snn3-D1 position in the atlas (Lin et al. 2021). Read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad39.py).

reports.name: QFhb.ifa-1BS (Capo x Arina)
reports.note: FHB resistance (AUDPC, spray inoculation, 2011-2013) and anther retention in the Capo x Arina winter wheat population; MQM mapping on a DArT/SSR map. Flanking markers read from the LOD profiles in Online Resource 3 (Fig. S1); LOD and effect sizes from the main paper (not uploaded) are not entered. FHB QTL on 1BS near 20 cM (wPt-3103 to wPt-666564), LOD above 3 in 2011; coincides with the AUDPC QTL of Draeger et al. (2007). Placed in silico: wPt-3103 51.351 Mb (DArT tag BLAST (this atlas)), wPt-6117 139.072 Mb (DArT tag BLAST (this atlas)). Placements off the stated chromosome arm were discarded (approximate centromere 241 Mb): wPt-666564 281.0 Mb. Xgwm11, just proximal of the LOD support interval (about 29 cM), places at 216.036 Mb (in-silico PCR), consistent with a 1BS QTL distal of it. Read from Online Resource 3 (Fig. S1), Nov 2026 (ad40.py, ad42.py).

reports.name: QBp.caas-3BL
reports.evidence: Fine mapping between M8 (TraesCS3B02G404200) and M10 (TraesCS3B02G404800), 1.7 Mb
reports.note: Black point resistance (the paper notes Bipolaris sorokiniana, Alternaria alternata and Fusarium proliferatum among causes). Linmai 2 x Zhong 892 RILs, seven environments; four NIL sets narrowed the QTL to 1.7 Mb with five genes (TraesCS3B02G404300 to 404700). Candidates: TraesCS3B02G404300, TraesCS3B02G404600 (ABI5 homologues) and TraesCS3B02G404700 (protein phosphatase; nonsynonymous SNP converted to a KASP marker, validated in 166 cultivars). Interval from the RefSeq v1.0 coordinates of the flanking gene models. Read from the journal PDF, Nov 2026 (ad57.py).
